### [[Trapping Ba137]]

We retrained yesterday's ion. And 1762nm was locked all day. 
surprising thing is that there was a dark ion in the trap all day. And we still didn't loose the ion. 
Now trapping again. 

We weren't able to trap a single Ba137. 
![[Capture 1.png|697]]
![[Screenshot 2026-03-24 183137.png|697]]

Overall we trapped 22 times but always with a dark ion. 
Each of the 100 attempts was at a different spot on the Target. 
It both very inspiring that we can trap Ba137 so often, but also concerning that we don't have any isotope selectivity. Tomorrow I will do a 554 scan to see where the ionization peak actually is.
